title: Fix all broken links in the documentation
body:
We have a lot of broken links in the documentation, mostly because we do things like `[/guide.html](guide)` and in production the real url is `/instantsearch.js/react/guide.html`.

Two ways to fix this:
- use the [base href](https://developer.mozilla.org/en/docs/Web/HTML/Element/base) attribute on the main webpage to define the base href for all relative (non http://) assets
- try to use h.publicPath helper in markdown files (not sure this is doable)

The base href option seems to be a very convenient way to do what we want without having to use h.publicPath everywhere.
